comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ROUND 3 RETURNED — synchronous, no interruptions, IN BAND (242,526 tokens / 117 tools against 120k-240k, a whisker over — the narrowing worked). All three round-2 fix claims verified: #785 held clean on all lenses; #784 and #786 held on their NAMED sites but the round uncovered adjacent misses the narrow claim did not cover. Stop: NOT reached, unanimous (all three lenses). Four children: #788 (major, security+SE convergent, DEMONSTRATED end-to-end on the built binary: clean_for_terminal and acquire.rs's clean_for_display filter only is_control, so bidi overrides U+202E, isolates U+2066-2069, zero-width U+200B/U+FEFF, and format chars pass to every rendered surface — the Trojan-Source/display-spoofing class, reachable through state-sourced scope/domain AND crosslink-sourced work-item/milestone; the project's OWN .crosslink/rules/web.md names exactly this — 'Zero-width chars, RTL overrides: Strip and re-evaluate' — so the toolkit contradicts its own threat list; not a regression, the is_control-only definition predates ff0d3a3f, which widened its reach uniformly), #789 (major SE: the broken-state human form's file-path line — broken.rs shown_path — interpolates raw one line below the #784 message fix; a hostile repo checked out with a control/bidi subdirectory name puts attacker-influenced bytes on cwd, so the path reaches the terminal uncleaned), #790 (major QE+SE: the #786 degenerate-budget falsifier goes VACUOUS — unwrap_or empty turns a failed field-locate into a passing assertion, so a budget-ignoring absence mutant escapes the falsifier written to catch exactly it; and the three main.rs diagnostic prints #784 cleaned have no red test — reverting them to raw passes the whole suite, needing a command-level malformed-artifact fixture), #791 (minor collector: free-form registry strings next_step_text and human_recovery render raw while the schema-pinned enum kind is cleaned — inconsistent trust model; #786's registered_absence read is dead in the live binary because acquire.rs hardcodes the absence words upstream, so the anti-drift purpose is unmet at the operative layer; the empty-fallback can still render the forbidden empty slot and the two renderers disagree on how they fail). TELEMETRY, chosen versus observed: model chosen=observed claude-fable-5 all three; effort chosen=observed (security/SE high, QE medium); band 120k-240k declared, 242,526 observed — essentially on the ceiling, the first verify round to land in its declared band because it was narrowed and ran uninterrupted. Fix pass follows.
